freeride.http_headers_helper: p=$(sed -n 's/.*"project"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([0-9a-fA-F-]\{36\}\)".*/\1/p' .freeride.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ -n "$p" ]; then printf '{"X-FreeRide-Version":"plugin-0.1.11","X-FreeRide-Project":"%s"}' "$p"; else printf '{"X-FreeRide-Version":"plugin-0.1.11"}'; fi
